title: AVIF decoding
what: An AVIF picture decoded into pixels: its container parsed, its colour and alpha items decoded as AV1 frames, and the YUV frame turned into RGB at the depth the header names.

title: Picture reading and redrawing
what: A picture read and redrawn for Telegram: its type, whether any pixel is transparent, laid on white as JPEG for upload, and brought inside the keeping size.

title: SVG drawing
what: An SVG picture drawn into pixels at its own size, with the machine's fonts for its text, as a default-density draw.
